annotations.title: Set how a number’s orders go to the CRM

description: Changes how one WhatsApp number sends its orders to the business’s CRM: switches it on or off, picks the CRM account used on the number, the pipeline, and the stage for each order status (a stage id from its pipelines, won or lost where the CRM keeps them apart from its stages, or keep; null puts a status back to its default). Switching on is on Starter and up, and is refused in words when a stage cannot be found in the CRM. Each call needs a confirmed call: without confirmation_token the call is a preview that returns what would happen and a token for a person to approve; called again with that token, it saves. Returns the setting.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

connector_account_id.description: A CRM account used on this number. Choosing another account clears the pipeline and stages chosen for the last one.

enabled.description: Send this number’s orders to the CRM (Starter and up).

id.description: The WhatsApp number, by its conn_ id.

pipeline_id.description: A pipeline of the account; null is the CRM’s first.

anyOf.description: Where the status moves the deal: `{stage_id}` (a stage of the pipeline), `{outcome: won|lost}` (where the CRM keeps won and lost apart from its stages, as Pipedrive does), or `{keep: true}` (the deal stays where it is).

stages.description: The stage per order status, only those given. Null puts a status back to its default.

name: update_crm_order_sync
title: Set how a number’s orders go to the CRM
